label: exploratory
purpose: Check that every metric computes on known cases (M3 brief) from the two smoke runs: TSTT recomputed from recorded link flows, mean trip time = TSTT/d, UE p95 = mean, R(SO) = 0, R(UE), R(FF) >= 0, flow conservation; Braess d = 6 against the analytic values with the EXP-001 code.
outcome: Metric checks pass on both runs (TSTT and mean recomputation error 0.0; UE p95 minus mean 3.4e-6 (GP) and 9.0e-5 (FW); R(SO) = 0 exactly; min R(UE, FF) = 0.0; node imbalance <= 1.5e-11). Finding for EXP-001: with gradient projection at RG <= 1e-6 (the frozen EXP-001 config) the Braess UE with link e stops at RG 7.3e-8 after 6 sweeps with TSTT 6.2e-5 from 552 (relative 1.1e-7), mean time 1.0e-5 and zigzag path flow 1.5e-6 from the analytic values. Five of six arm/network combinations match within 1e-6 absolute; this one does not. The protocol (EXP-001 item 5) mentions a relative gap of 1e-10 for this run, but the frozen config uses 1e-6; the confirmatory run is made with the frozen config, and the conflict is reported to the owner (D-012 gaps). No rule was changed after this smoke.
